LEAF b0ac silverish-parodic-quoll — COMPLETE AND PUSHED.

4e VALIDATION: implementer converted all six sites and the FULL held-out oracle passed 20/20 on the
FIRST attempt. No re-dispatch needed.
DEFECT-SEEDED MUTATION (sandboxed, backup+trap restore):
  baseline                                                    16 passed
  M1 shared temp name re-introduced INSIDE atomic_write        2 FAILED  <- teeth
  M2 cursor site reverted to its own hand-rolled shared temp   2 FAILED  <- teeth
  restored                                                    16 passed
4f: make lint rc=0, mypy clean 728 files, 20/20 tests, complexity ratchet active=39 new=0 increased=0.
Implementer's own broader sweep: 4402 passed / 14 skipped across the touched areas.
4g: Gerrit change 2505, commit 49b6a4563d4f, 8 files / 322 insertions.
https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2505

IMPLEMENTER JUDGEMENT WORTH KEEPING: it declined to invent a docs home. docs/concurrency.md's
atomic_write mention is scoped to tickets-branch write-lock discipline, not temp naming, so it put
the audited-site table AND the audit's negative result into fsutil.py's module docstring — the
helper whose docstring already enumerates the sites it consolidates — and told me plainly that
placing it in docs/ prose was my call. That is the right instinct over fabricating a docs file.

STACK: 2503 (8ce5 parity) -> 2504 (f9b9 mirrors) -> 2505 (b0ac atomic writes).

9ca8 THIRD REMEDIATION. Re-review #2 blocked on two more real gaps I introduced:
 - E2: the ci_gate row read '29 / 251', a two-number notation unique to that row, so it was
   ambiguous WHICH number the baseline locks. Now '280 (29 scripts + 251 run-steps)'.
 - G6: the marker was specified as 'at its definition site', but ci_gate (script glob + YAML steps)
   and test_helper (glob) have NO definition line, so the exception path was unusable for exactly
   those kinds. Added a per-detection-shape placement table (definition line / string literal /
   filename glob first-20-lines / YAML step line) naming what each detector scans, plus AC7 and AC8
   covering a glob-detected and a YAML-detected marker.
Also split the remaining compound ACs (advisory P6) into 16 atomic ones, each with a 'Verified by'.
Then hit the 8,000-char plan-review ADMISSION cap at 9,838 then 8,116 chars — review-plan refuses
admission above it — so trimmed the Context grounding and the --lock rationale to 7,860. Review #3
running.
